I'm David Lindelöf. My work and interests span statistics, data science,
software engineering, and scientific computing, informed by a background in
physics and building science.

I use this blog to work through ideas in public, with practical explanations,
reproducible analyses, and lessons from building software and using data to
answer real questions. Follow along if you value technically careful writing
that connects theory with practice.

I occasionally help teams with statistical analysis, experiment design, and
practical R training---especially when a problem sits between statistical
methodology and implementation. If you think I might be useful for a project or
workshop, feel free to get in touch.

The easiest way to reach me is through
[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dlindelof/).
